automation_evidence.quote: Time Series Augmented Generation (TSAG), where an LLM agent delegates quantitative tasks to verifiable, external tools.

evidence.quote: As expected, raw models not augmented with the tools provided ultimate Return Rate but showed zero Match Accuracy and negligible LLM-assessed Accuracy with high Hallucination Rate

practical_problems.note: tool-grounded vs raw LLM hallucination and match accuracy; forecasting tools are simple extrapolation stubs, so only tool invocation is measured
